definitions.explanation: The tough, fibrous connective tissue that connects bones to other bones, providing stability to joints.

examples.japanese: {膝|ひざ}の{靭帯|じんたい}を{損傷|そんしょう}した。
examples.english: I injured the ligament in my knee.

examples.japanese: {靭帯|じんたい}{断裂|だんれつ}で{手術|しゅじゅつ}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: Surgery is needed for the torn ligament.

examples.japanese: {靭帯|じんたい}を{伸|の}ばしてしまった。

notes:
{靭帯|じんたい} is the tough connective tissue that holds bones together at joints, providing stability. Ligament injuries are common in sports, particularly in the knee.

TYPES:
- {前十字|ぜんじゅうじ}{靭帯|じんたい} (ACL): anterior cruciate ligament
- {後十字|こうじゅうじ}{靭帯|じんたい} (PCL): posterior cruciate ligament
- {側副|そくふく}{靭帯|じんたい}: collateral ligament

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {靭帯|じんたい}{損傷|そんしょう}: ligament injury
- {靭帯|じんたい}{断裂|だんれつ}: torn ligament
- {靭帯|じんたい}を{伸|の}ばす: to stretch/strain a ligament
- {靭帯|じんたい}{再建|さいけん}{手術|しゅじゅつ}: ligament reconstruction surgery

RELATED BODY PARTS:
- {腱|けん}: tendon (connects muscle to bone)
- {筋肉|きんにく}: muscle
- {軟骨|なんこつ}: cartilage
- {関節|かんせつ}: joint
